candidates.selection_reason: Symmetric 2x2 preprocessing-by-sign probe, not a same-capacity comparison: within D8's five-epoch smoke, identity_standardized_v0 wins for PDG+13 (3.4925 medium / 3.6094 small) while cartesian_log1p_pz_v0 wins for PDG-13 (3.5164 vs 3.6739 identity, see B2). This challenger tests whether that sign-dependent preprocessing flip survives multi-seed convergence training or is five-epoch/single-seed noise. DISCLOSED CONFOUND: the champion (A1) is capacity=medium (280656 params); this challenger is capacity=small (37416 params), so preprocessing and capacity both vary relative to A1 -- this is not a clean single-variable comparison against A1. A same-capacity, preprocessing-only comparison for track A would instead be identity_standardized_v0/small (ranking_value=3.609397486135574), which was not selected because it is materially indistinguishable from A1's own small-capacity identity run and does not probe a new scientific question by itself.
